steps.what: skim milk, whey protein, lactose, oils and emulsifiers
steps.note: Blended in tanks with skim milk warmed to about 60 °C, minerals and vitamins going in by how heat-sensitive they are.
Two-stage, at 100–120 bar then 20–40 bar, to make a stable emulsion.
Spray-dried to 2.5–3.5 % moisture with air at 160–190 °C going in and 85–95 °C coming out.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. 19 Milk and whey powder

sources.text: The mixing, heat treatment and homogenising of formula are from Wikipedia; the homogenising pressures and the spray drying of baby-food powder from Tetra Pak.
